why: This chickpea curry is packed with plant protein fibre and vitamins from sweet potato and spinach. Fully fasting compliant and deeply satisfying for an evening meal.

steps: Cook rice according to packet instructions
Fry garlic in oil for 30 seconds
Add cumin turmeric and stir for 30 seconds

Cook covered for 15 minutes until sweet potato is soft

Add spinach and stir until wilted
Season with salt and serve over rice
